text.config.soul/config.title: Soul
text.config.soul/config.dev.warning: Only change if you know what you're doing.
text.config.soul/config.option.general.u: When on, Soul HUDs scale with Minecraft's GUI Scale setting (vanilla behavior). When off (default), they render at a fixed on-screen pixel size regardless of the GUI Scale slider.
Global scale multiplier applied to every Soul HUD element, on top of each element's individual scale (adjusted via /soul gui mouse-wheel). 1.0 = no change.

Master switch for Soul HUD panel backgrounds. When off, panels render with no dark backdrop (text + shapes only). Per-HUD overrides in /soul gui can opt INDIVIDUAL HUDs out when this is on, but cannot force a background on when this is off — global wins.

Use Minecraft's vanilla / resource-pack font for Soul HUD text instead of the bundled Inter NanoVG fonts. Default (off) keeps the crisp Inter rendering. Per-HUD overrides in /soul gui follow the same global-wins rule.

Render HUD text with a black drop shadow beneath the glyphs (Minecraft-style). Off (default) is cleaner against the dark HUD backdrop; on helps legibility when the HUD background is transparent or sits over bright terrain. Per-HUD overrides in /soul gui follow the same global-wins rule.
Drop shadow thickness in physical (monitor) pixels. 1 = thin / default, 4 = heavy. Only takes effect when HUD Text Shadow is on.

Use a heavier Inter font weight for HUD body text (Regular → Medium, Medium → SemiBold). Off (default) keeps the framework's calibrated weight pairs. On boosts contrast for readability at small GUI scales. Per-HUD overrides in /soul gui follow the same global-wins rule.
text.config.soul/config.option.general.c: Right-click any chat message (with the chat box open) to copy it to your clipboard. Shift+right-click: only the line under the cursor (for multi-line server banners). Ctrl+right-click: full message with §-color codes preserved. Default off.

Prefix the mod's conversational party / all-chat announcements (Double Hook response, Legion stats on dragon death, dragon profit) with [Soul] so other players can tell the message came from a Soul mod user. Protocol messages (!ptme alerts, waypoint shares) are NOT prefixed to keep them compatible with other mods' parsers. Default on.
text.config.soul/config.option.farming.s: Show the Seasoning HUD overlay. Position with /soul gui. Tracking always runs regardless of this toggle — the value updates from chat (RARE CROP! drops) and from opening the Harvest Feast menu.
Append `/<max>` to the Total line — the highest milestone target known from the Harvest Feast menu.
Show a `Next Milestone: X/Y` line, or `Maxed` if there's no further target.
Show a stopwatch line that runs while breaking Garden crops, with a `(Paused)` suffix during idle.
Show seasonings per hour — chat-driven gain divided by the seasoning farming-time clock.
text.config.soul/config.option.combat.dr: Show the Dragon Profit HUD overlay in The End — drops + coin value tracker. Position with /soul gui. Tracking always runs when in The End regardless of this toggle. Default off.
Send Legion amount on dragon death
When a dragon dies, announce 'Legion: N players (X.XX%)' — the nearby-player count (within 30 blocks) plus your Legion boost percentage. Routes through the sub-toggle below. Default off.
When on, broadcast the Legion line to party chat via /pc (silently skipped when not in a party). When off, show it only in your own client chat. Default on.

Five seconds after the first loot stand renders for a dragon kill, announce '<Type> profit: <coins>' — gross drop value at instant-buy prices, no eye-cost subtraction (per-kill, not aggregate). Routes through the sub-toggle below. Default off.
When on, broadcast the dragon-profit line to party chat via /pc (silently skipped when not in a party). When off, show it only in your own client chat. Default on.
text.config.soul/config.option.dev.track: Master switch for the chat-driven Fishing Tracker (sea-creature catches, double-hooks, cocoons, festival counters). When off, no fishing data is recorded — the Fishing HUD has nothing to display. Default on.

Master switch for all profit-tracker data layers (dragon profit, future slayer / mining / fishing profit). Off ⇒ the bazaar + lowest-BIN price cache stays idle and individual profit HUDs render nothing regardless of their own toggles. Default on.
text.config.soul/config.option.dev.keybi: Copies a JSON dump of the currently open container screen (chest contents, slot map, title) to the clipboard.
Copies a JSON dump of the item the cursor is hovering inside a container.
Copies a JSON dump of the item in the player's main hand.
Copies the scoreboard sidebar lines as text.
Copies the tab list (header, footer, players) as JSON.
Copy JSON of entities within 30 blocks.
text.config.soul/config.option.general.f: Prevents the duplicate sneak packet that triggers some servers' AFK detection.

Expands the cactus targeting hitbox to a full cube and removes its collision. Fixes the breaking-stalls when cactus farming at ≥20 BPS in Hypixel SkyBlock Garden — the modern client's inset hitbox lets the crosshair slip through the gap between offset rows, which eventually triggers Hypixel's anti-cheat to throttle break packets.
text.config.soul/config.option.render.hi: Hides the floating name of the item currently held in your hand.
text.config.soul/config.option.render.sh: Adds the internal SkyBlock item ID to item tooltips.
text.config.soul/config.option.render.ol: Restores the pre-1.14 sneaking eye height (1.54 blocks).
text.config.soul/config.option.render.hi: Hide the active status-effect panel that appears to the left of the player inventory and other container screens.
Hide the active status-effect icons that appear in the top-right corner of the screen during gameplay.
Highlight the Pest Vest instead of the Pesthunter's Cloak.
text.config.soul/config.option.fishing.c: Sends a chat message in party chat when a double hook occurs.
text.config.soul/config.option.fishing.f: Show the Fishing HUD overlay. Position with /soul gui. Tracking always runs regardless of this toggle.
Show a countdown line while a Fishing Festival is active.
Roll Double Hook counts into the Catches column / total. Affects every creature row AND the bottom totals line so the numbers stay consistent.
Roll Cocoon counts into the Catches column / total. Affects every creature row AND the bottom totals line so the numbers stay consistent.
text.config.soul/config.option.mining.mi: Send !ptme to party chat when enough Lapis Corpses are in the mineshaft.
Minimum Lapis Corpses required to trigger !ptme.
Send !ptme to party chat when a Vanguard Corpse appears.
Overlay with looted / total corpse counts by type. Move with /soul gui.
Send !ptme when you first see Littlefoot (line-of-sight required).
After party warp, share Littlefoot coordinates so waypoint mods auto-pin them.
text.config.soul/config.option.notificat: Show on-screen alerts when chat messages match a configured rule. Future: configurable rule list under `/soul chatNotifications`.
text.config.soul/config.option.sync.enab: Sync mod data with the Soul backend so settings, GUI layouts, and stats follow you between machines. Local files remain the source of truth — if the backend is unreachable, the mod keeps working with local data.
text.config.soul/config.option.sync.sync: Sync the HUD positions and scales from config/soul/gui_layout.json.
Sync tracked counters (seasonings, milestone targets, etc.) from config/soul/stats.json.
text.config.soul/config.option.dev.updat: Checks for new Soul versions on startup and shows a notice when an update is available.
text.config.soul/config.option.dev.backe: Leave empty to use the default (sky.soulreturns.com).
text.config.soul/config.option.dev.debug: Master switch for in-game console logging from the mod. When off, the mod is silent on the console except for warnings and errors. Sub-toggles below filter individual categories.
Tee Soul-only log output to config/soul/logs/soul-latest.log. Disable for zero disk writes.

Also log every parsed chat message + command execution to soul-latest.log. Spammy during active play — leave off unless debugging chat-driven features. Never reaches the in-game console regardless of this setting.
Log all backend HTTP traffic (URLs, auth, cache hits, response codes).
Log Mercure SSE connection events and incoming messages.
Send mineshaft visit summary to backend for personal stats.
